description: This is a Java JUnit test class for testing the MongoReadJournal component in a persistence framework using Akka Streams with MongoDB. It contains setup and teardown of a MongoDB test resource, Akka actor system initialization, and multiple test cases for snapshot and journal pids extraction.

classes.name: MongoReadJournalIT
classes.description: JUnit test class for MongoReadJournal, testing its methods with a real MongoDB instance and using Akka Streams for data handling.

methods.name: startMongoResource
methods.description: Initializes and starts a MongoDB resource for testing.

methods.name: stopMongoResource
methods.description: Stops the MongoDB resource after tests are completed.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the Akka ActorSystem, Materializer, and initializes the MongoReadJournal before each test.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Cleans up resources: drops test collections and shuts down the ActorSystem after each test.

methods.name: streamLatestSnapshotsWithBatchCutOffWithinSamePid
methods.description: Test for retrieving latest snapshots where the batch is split by size, ensuring correct snapshot retrieval.

methods.name: streamLatestSnapshotsWithDeletedSnapshots
methods.description: Test verifying behavior when snapshots have been marked as deleted, ensuring only valid latest snapshots are returned.

methods.name: extractJournalPidsFromEventsAndNotSnapshots
methods.description: Test to verify extraction of pids from journal entries ignoring snapshots.

methods.name: extractJournalPidsAboveALowerBound
methods.description: Test for extracting pids above a specified pid lower bound.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Utility method to insert documents into specified MongoDB collections.
